name: yellow-claudemod
description: Claude Code mod that records the model each subagent runs on and can downshift listed Opus reviewers near a usage limit

downshift_enabled.title: Downshift Opus reviewers near a usage limit
downshift_enabled.description: When on, listed Opus-tier agents (not security-sentinel) run on Sonnet once the fullest Max usage window passes the threshold.

downshift_threshold.title: Downshift threshold (percent)
downshift_threshold.description: Percent of the fullest usage window (five_hour or seven_day) at which the downshift starts. 1 to 100.
